205068.description:
When college student U-Yun meets the quiet and introverted TA Jin-Hyeong, he immediately asks him out, saying he wants to get to know him more. After just three days of dating, Jin-Hyeong moves in with him, and that’s when he starts showing a completely different wild side. All of his BL novel and comic consumption has perverted his perception of the perfect first time with his boyfriend. He’s thought of it all, from doing it in the subway to having U-Yun role-play as a K-pop idol. But as weird as Jin-Hyeong’s ideas are, U-Yun doesn’t entirely hate it...?

(Source: Tappytoon)

205130.description:
After shocking the world with Parasyte, Hitoshi Iwaaki is back with a series he's been aching to tackle since even before his pro manga debut! A historical epic set in ancient times, Historie tells the story of Eumenes, a young man with quick wits and a vast destiny to fulfill. In time, he'll become a famed army commander and personal secretary to Alexander the Great—but the road to this glory is fraught with danger… "

(Source: K Manga)

205909.description:
On the surface, Satoko has it all—she’s beautiful, the daughter of a nobleman, and at a prime age for marriage. Unfortunately, she is also quite ill and only has a short time left to live. Before she can secure a marriage that will redeem her worth in her family’s eyes, she finds herself the target of the mysterious assassin Shinpei, and her plans are put in jeopardy. In order to save herself, she makes a desperate proposal—of marriage! When it comes to love, however, Shinpei takes “until death do we part” seriously.

(Source: VIZ Media)

205905.description:
After the cataclysmic destruction of Nanhuang Continent, young Xu Qing, the sole survivor, accidentally obtains a mysterious purple crystal, thus beginning his cultivation journey.

To survive, he joins the Thunder Squad, experiencing life-or-death battles and forging deep bonds with his teammates. Through trials and tribulations, Xu Qing transforms from a lone wolf into a warrior protecting others, becoming a top expert in the Eight Sects Alliance through his exceptional wisdom and willpower. Facing his nemesis, he resolutely embarks on a journey to uncover the ultimate secrets of the remnants of the divine face in order to protect those around him.

(Source: Youku, translated)
